verdict.rationale: Godot ships multiple official, well-documented SDK surfaces a developer or agent can build against: GDScript and C# scripting APIs, GDExtension/C++ for native extension, a headless CLI for scripted builds/exports/CI (godot-probe-1, godot-docs-3/12), EditorScript/EditorInterface APIs for editor automation, and a first-party GDScript LSP with an official VS Code client for external tooling integration (godot-probe-rt-4). A keyless JSON Asset Library API is also available for programmatic querying (godot-probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: a dedicated AI-agent-oriented SDK or higher-level remote-control REST/gRPC API, and any llms.txt/machine-readable docs mirror (both probed as 404).
